_comments.constitutional_rules: PROJECT_BRIEF §5 + §10 and CONSTITUTION Law 4 (Place over Person) and Law 2 (Voice Signatures Sacred). NO Team USA athlete names anywhere — current, retired, or historical. NO forbidden words ('inspirational', 'inspiring', 'hero', 'overcame', 'despite' in disability context, 'warrior', 'fighter' in disability context, 'wheelchair-bound', 'suffers from', 'former Olympian', 'past Olympian', 'ex-Olympian', 'retired Olympian'). NO NGB names ('USATF', 'USA Swimming', 'USOPC'). Approved Games naming only.
